description: xdcr-filtering-data-type-conversion.md states that NaN float values are treated as less than any other real number for XDCR's own comparison purposes, so the operators <= and >= return true against NaN - explicitly stated to differ from the Go standard library's own NaN comparison semantics, which return false for the same operators. A real, citable implementation quirk with no promoted concept yet (too fine-grained for this round's batch), left as a candidate for a future round focused specifically on XDCR filtering internals.
